[package]
name = "bivvy"
version = "1.7.0"

repository = "https://github.com/bivvy-dev/bivvy"
keywords = ["cli", "setup", "development", "automation"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "development-tools"]

[dependencies]
# CLI framework
clap = { version = "4.5.56", features = ["derive", "env"] }

# Interactive prompts
dialoguer = "0.12.0"
console = "0.16.2"

# Progress indicators
indicatif = "0.18.3"

# Serialization
serde = { version = "1.0.228", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.149"

# YAML parsing

marked-yaml = "0.8.0"

anyhow = "1.0.100"
thiserror = "2.0.18"

# File system
dirs = "6.0.0"
walkdir = "2.5.0"
glob = "0.3.3"

# Process execution

# Hashing (for project identification)
sha2 = "0.10"
hex = "0.4.3"

# Random number generation (for session IDs)
getrandom = "0.2"

# Regular expressions (for version extraction)

# Logging

clap_complete = "4.5.65"

open = "5"
urlencoding = "2"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_cmd = "2.1.2"

predicates = "3.1.3"
tempfile = "3.24.0"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[profile.release]
lto = true
strip = true
codegen-units = 1
opt-level = "z"
